title: Scope bare-name source owner trust to the configured project root
outcome: Naming and ordinary observation exclude PATH-resolved owners inside the configured project even when measuring a different named worktree.
acceptance: Naming and ordinary observation resolve a bare-name owner against the configured project root and measure the intended named root without changing explicit trusted-path semantics.
A fixture with a PATH owner inside the project but outside the measured worktree is refused; an external trusted owner still succeeds.
